note: Production Rive scene uses the mother image and deterministic source-pixel rig layers. ROUND7: full decompose — face/hair/choker/belt/hem/legs crops + selective Mesh on legs/fingers/coat-tails. Finger phalanx sub-crops skipped. ROUND8: vest/shorts/belt-band, continuous leg skin, all cut from the mother pixels.  ROUND9: one continuous hand crop per side (wrist+palm+thumb+fingers cut once from the mother, skinned to a finger skeleton); hand/ribbon/thigh pixels removed from cuff, sleeve and hem crops. ROUND10: cuff band drawn once (sleeve crops lose the baked-in band), orange ribbon shards removed from cuff/sleeve crops. ROUND10 hand pieces: palm + 5 finger pieces cut from the single ROUND9 hand crop by capsule ownership (hinge/edge overlap <= 2.5px), each skinned only to its own bones. ROUND13 hem: coat-tail crops removed (fully hidden duplicates); hem ribbons unchanged pixels, now skinned. ROUND13 hair: side-lock pixels moved (not copied) out of the head-group crops into hair-lock-{l,r}. ROUND13 collar: hair-l strand tip on the shoulder moved (not copied) into hair-tip-l. ROUND14 eyes: eye pixels moved (not copied) into per-part eye layers; eyelid skin inpainted from neighbouring skin. ROUND14 brows: brow-line px moved into brow-l/r; the hair under them in head.png is inpainted from the neighbouring bangs. ROUND14 bangs: bang px moved into bangs-{a,b,c}; the forehead under them in head.png is inpainted from neighbouring skin (hair px kept where never uncovered).
